text: SUBJECT: Marlboro Adventure Team Tracking Project
As mentioned in Mike Szymanczyk's December 10 memo concerning the
Marlboro Adventure Team, a tracking system has been designed that allows
Sales to monitor our initial retail execution and progress throughout each of the
eight weeks of the tracking period.
Attached are documents that outline the process and explain the procedures for
data entry at the Sales Representative level. In addition, an example of a
completed Sales Rep Tracking Sheet is provided. A blank Sales Rep Tracking
Sheet is also attached in case additional copies are needed for distribution.
